sentences.text: 6.2023 adeb Crr 2001 of 2023 In the matter of : Smt. Monisha Kaur .......Petitioner Mr. Debasis
Kar Mr. Soumen Ghosh ...for the petitioner

This is an application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for quashing the order dated 27.03.2023 whereby the learned Court below was pleased to reject the protest petition filed by the petitioner in connection with Baranagar P.S.
Case No. 133/2020 dated 15.03.2020.

The main grievance of the petitioner is that the investigating officer after completion of investigation has submitted charge sheet against the accused persons under Section 498A only, but he has omitted the Sections 306/354/323/34 of the Indian Penal Code mentioned in the FIR.

Petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon the opposite party through the office of public prosecutor with an intimation of the matter will appear 4 (four) weeks after vacation.

(Ajoy Kumar Mukherjee, J.)
